title: Vichara: Design-First Learning Platform for CS/DSA
summary: A four-stage Design → Code → Trace → Reflect platform that asks students to show algorithmic understanding before they write code. Includes a line-by-line execution tracer, recursion call-stack visualisation and a Socratic tutor that guides without writing code for the student.

title: MedVision Reflex: Dermoscopy Diagnostic Support
summary: Deployment of the DermSegClassify segmentation and classification research as a live diagnostic-support prototype, with a FastAPI inference backend behind a Cloudflare Tunnel.

title: ARCMED V3: Dual-Encoder Skin Disease Classifier
summary: Interface for the ARCMED research line: a Swin-T + EfficientNet-B3 dual-encoder skin disease classifier served through FastAPI.

title: SOC-Eye: SIEM Visual RAG Benchmark
summary: Interactive benchmark comparing text-based and image-based retrieval-augmented generation for SIEM alert triage across 153,733 alerts drawn from NSL-KDD, CICIDS and CTU-13.

title: APEX v3.0: AI-Assisted Course Exemption Review
summary: Indexes 291 courses from institutional syllabus PDFs with a universal parser, then combines FAISS retrieval with LLM reasoning to support exemption review decisions.

title: GenAI Classroom: Multi-Modal Learning Platform
summary: Classroom platform with four modes (Debate Arena, Code Lab, Teacher Studio, Research Supervisor) and a shared prompt refiner, working across four LLM providers.

title: Expression Engine: Real-Time Expression Recognition
summary: Webcam-based facial blendshape detection driving a parametric anime-style reaction rig with a 48-expression set and text/voice-to-emoji mapping.

title: Samvada: AI Language Learning Companion
summary: Language-learning app built around “Vani”, an adaptive companion covering 18 languages including Kannada, Tamil, Telugu and Malayalam, with voice input/output, role-play scenarios and a built-in translator.

title: Multilingual AI Translator
summary: Publicly accessible real-time translation web application.
